title: An Act Punishing the Crime of Coup D′ÉTAT by Amending Articles 134, 135 and 136 of Chapter One, Title Three of Act No. 3815 (RPC), and for Other Purposes
notes: Generated from LexCode/Codals/md/ra_6968_1990.md via offline/deterministic parse.

changes.new_text: Article 134. *Rebellion or insurrection – How committed.* – "he crime of rebellion or insurrection is committed by rising and taking arms against the Government for the purpose of removing from the allegiance to said Government or its laws, the territory of the Republic of the Philippines or any part thereof, of any body of land, naval or other armed forces, or depriving the Chief Executive or the Legislature, wholly or partially, of any of their powers or prerogatives.
changes.amendment_description: **Republic Act No. 6968** (1990-10-24) amended **Article 134** to restate the definition and manner of commission of the crimes of *rebellion* and *insurrection*, aligning the text with the policy of the same Act to criminalize *coup d’état* and related conduct. The version shown here is the **literal codal text** carried from the official amendatory source (not an AI paraphrase).

changes.new_text: Art. 134-A. *Coup D′ÉTAT.* – How committed. – The crime of coup D′ÉTAT is a swift attack accompanied by violence, intimidation, threat, strategy or stealth, directed against duly constituted authorities of the Republic of the Philippines, or any military camp or installation, communications networks, public utilities or other facilities needed for the exercise and continued possession of power, singly or simultaneously carried out anywhere in the Philippines by any person or persons, belonging to the military or police or holding any public office or employment, with or without civilian support or participation, for the purpose of seizing or diminishing state power.
changes.amendment_description: **Republic Act No. 6968** **inserted Article 134-A**, creating the new felony of *coup d’état*: a **swift attack** (with violence, intimidation, threat, strategy, or stealth) against the Government, military installations, or critical public facilities, by military, police, or public officers (with or without civilian support) to **seize or diminish state power**. The text is stored **verbatim** from the amendatory act.

changes.new_text:
Art. 135. *Penalty for rebellion, insurrection or coup D′ÉTAT.* – Any person who promotes, maintains or heads a rebellion or insurrection shall suffer the penalty of reclusion perpetua.

Any person merely participating or executing the commands of others in a rebellion or insurrection shall suffer the penalty of reclusion temporal.

Any person who leads or in any manner directs or commands others to undertake a coup D′ÉTAT shall suffer the penalty of reclusion perpetua.

Any person in the government service who participates, or executes directions or commands of others in undertaking a coup D′ÉTAT shall suffer the penalty of reclusion temporal in its maximum period.

Any person not in the government service who participates, or in any manner supports, finances, abets or aids in undertaking a coup D′ÉTAT shall suffer the penalty of prision mayor in its maximum period.

When the rebellion, insurrection, or coup D′ÉTAT shall be under the command of unknown leaders, any person who in fact directed the others, spoke for them, signed receipts and other documents issued in their name, or performed similar acts, on behalf of the rebels shall be deemed a leader of such rebellion, insurrection, or coup D′ÉTAT.
changes.amendment_description: **Article 135** was comprehensively **repealed and replaced** to prescribe **penalties** for *rebellion*, *insurrection*, and the **new** crime of *coup d’état*—distinguishing leaders, participants, public officers, private supporters, and the special case of “unknown” rebel leadership. Text below matches the **published amendatory act** (literal apply).

changes.new_text:
Art. 136. *Conspiracy and proposal to commit coup D′ÉTAT, rebellion or insurrection.* – The conspiracy and proposal to commit coup D′ÉTAT shall be punished by prision mayor in its minimum period and a fine which shall not exceed eight thousand pesos (P8,000.00).

The conspiracy and proposal to commit rebellion or insurrection shall be punished, respectively, by prision correccional in its maximum period and a fine which shall not exceed five thousand pesos (P5,000.00), and by prision correccional in its medium period and a fine not exceeding two thousand pesos (P2,000.00).
changes.amendment_description: **Article 136** was amended so that *conspiracy* and *proposal* now explicitly cover **coup d’état** in addition to *rebellion* and *insurrection*, with **graduated** imprisonment ranges and **peso caps** for fines. The codal text is the **statutory text** of Republic Act No. 6968, applied literally for fidelity.
